fact: ANAM's agro-hydro-meteorological bulletin no. 14 of 2024 (2nd dekad of September 2024), issued by the pluridisciplinary working group, includes a section 'La saison selon les images' with CHIRPS satellite rainfall estimates and anomaly maps and NDVI vegetation index and anomaly maps for Chad.
title: Bulletin Agro-hydro-météorologique, 2ème décade de sept, N° 14 de l'année 2024
publisher: Agence Nationale de la Météorologie (ANAM), Groupe de Travail Pluridisciplinaire du Tchad
